from_quote: Convention foreseeing this danger, have so worded the article, that if the people should at any future time judge necessary, they may diminish the representation
rationale: Refers to the wording of "the article" on the number of representatives, which sets only an upper limit on their number; this clause is the one that fixes that number.

from_quote: The federal representatives are to be chosen by the votes of the people. Every freeman is an elector. The same qualification which enables you to vote for state representatives, gives you a federal voice.
rationale: States that federal representatives are chosen by the people and that the qualification for voting for state representatives gives a federal vote, the provisions of this clause.
to_quote: the Electors in each State shall have the Qualifications requisite for Electors of the most numerous Branch of the State Legislature

from_quote: Your own assemblies are to regulate the formalities of this choice, and unless they betray you, you cannot be betrayed. But perhaps it may be said, Congress have a power to control this formality as to the time and places of electing, and we allow they have
rationale: Names the state assemblies' power to regulate elections and the power of Congress to control "the time and places of electing," the two parts of this clause.

from_quote: The national legislature consists of two houses, a senate and house of representatives.
rationale: States that the national legislature consists of a senate and house of representatives, as this clause provides.
to_quote: which shall consist of a Senate and House of Representatives

from_quote: The senate is to be chosen by the assemblies of the particular states
rationale: States that the senate is to be chosen by the state assemblies, the mode of choice in this clause.
